purpose: Contributor/coding-agent policy aligned with DHP runtime: official cloud providers only, free entitlement first, no local runtime.

providers.notes: Use only while the selected model is currently verified as zero-cost. Do not substitute a paid model unless explicit paid policy is enabled.
Dynamic free pool; availability and selected underlying model may change.
Resolve the currently eligible Free Tier model at execution time; never upgrade billing automatically.
Do not route to models that require a paid plan. Treat paid-plan-required and quota exhaustion as rotation signals.

rotationRules: Never start a request on a provider that is known to require payment for the selected model.
At NEAR_LIMIT, preserve the strongest remaining free quota for hard reasoning/debugging and route routine work elsewhere.
On RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, rotate to the next compatible zero-cost cloud provider without changing task state, spec, or repository context.
On RECOVERED after a quota reset or cooldown, return the provider to the eligible pool automatically.
Use a different provider for review when practical to reduce correlated implementation/review errors.
If no compatible zero-cost cloud provider is available, stop metered execution instead of incurring cost.
